sections.text:
هذا 
 المستند يختص بعمل الصيانة الدورية لطلمبة التبريد الرئيسية وقد تم إنشاء 
 المستند بمعرفة كل من السيد المهندس / محمد سليم سالمان والسيد المهندس / أحمد 
 مصطفى الصباغ بتاريخ 14 يونيو 2003 
 وتمت المراسلات الاليكترونية خلال الانترنت بمساعدة المهندس/ محمد سليم سالمان

وقد تم تنفيذه بناءً على الخبرة السابقة بمعرفة السيد المهندس / أحمد مصطفى 
 الصباغ وتمت مراجعة المستند بمعرفة السيد المهندس / عبودة البنا مهندس 
 التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة و السيد المهندس / محمد السيد عبد الغفار مدير عام 
 المحطة واعتماده من السيد المهندس / عوض محمد فتحي رئيس قطاع المحطات.

items: إصدار أمر شغل معتمد من الجهة المختصة.
استخدام معدات الآمان من خوذة وحذاء وسماعة.
تسوير مكان العمل ووضع لوحات تحذيرية.
عزل الطلمبة كهربياً وإخراج المفتاح من الخدمة.
عزل الطلمبة ميكانيكياً بقفل بلفي الطرد والسحب وقفل بلف تبريد الكراسي.
خوذة وأحذية أمان

بلنكو أو ترفل وملحقاته (وايرات 
 واقفال).
طقم عدة كامل مفاتيح بأنواعها بلدي و مشرشر وألن كي.
قدمة وباكوليس.
زرجينة 8ً وفلر.
دكم خشبية.

sections.text: قطع الغيار التي يمكن تغييرها حسب الحالة:

rows:
أفصل الطلمبة 
 ثم فك أطراف الموتور

فك الكوبلنج العلوي وفك مسامير ربط الموتور ورفعه باستخدام 
 الونش.
ضع الموتور على دكم خشب في وضع رأسي على الأرض.
فك مسامير قاعدة الطلمبة وفك مسامير خط الطرد.

ارفع 
 الطلمبة باستخدام ونش عنبر الشاطئ.
ضع الطلمبة على الأرض على دكم خشب.
قياس خلوص الريشة مع الجزء الثابت.

فك الجزء الثابت حول الريشة Mouth 
 .

فك ريشة الطلمبة باستخدام الزرجينة ومراجعتها وقياس الخلوص 
 وتدوينه.

فك وصلة Duct 
 الطلمبة وإخراجها ( الوصلة السفلية).
فك كوبلنج تجميع العمود وإخراج الوصلة السفلية للعمود.
فك الكوبلنج السفلي وإخراج الوصلة العلوية للعمود.
اكشف على كراسي الطلمبة Rubber Coated.
الكشف على جلب العمود المناظرة للكراسي.
الكشف على كرسي الدفع ومراجعته وإخراجه حسب الحالة.

بعد الكشف والتأكد من الحالة يتم التغيير حسب الحالة ويتم 
 التجميع بطريقة عكسية.

بعد تمام الإصلاح وإعادة التركيب يتم التشغيل والاطمئنان على 
 الحالة من حيث:

- الإهتزاز - ضغط وكمية الطرد - أمبير 
 تشغيل الموتور 
 - 
 درجة حرارة زيت كرسي الدفع 
 وذلك طبقاً لمنحنيات الأداء

Procedure:
Periodic maintenance every 32,000 operating hours or every 4 years, whichever is sooner (I1-Y4)

sections_en.text: This document covers the periodic maintenance of the main cooling pump. The document was prepared by Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman and Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh on 14 June 2003, and the electronic correspondence was carried out over the Internet with the assistance of Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman.

It was implemented based on previous experience by Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh. The document was reviewed by Eng. Abouda El-Banna, Inspection and Quality Control Engineer, and Eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Abdel Ghaffar, General Manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy, Head of the Power Stations Sector.

items: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority.
Use safety equipment: helmet, shoes and ear muffs.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Isolate the pump electrically and take the switch out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the discharge and suction valves and the bearing cooling valve.
Helmet and safety shoes
Chain block or Tirfor and its accessories (wire ropes and locks).
Complete tool set: wrenches of all types, open-end, ring and Allen keys.
Vernier caliper and dial caliper.
8-inch puller and feeler gauge.
Wooden blocks.

sections_en.text: Spare parts that may be changed as required:
Work steps to be carried out

rows: Disconnect the pump, then disconnect the motor terminals
Drain the oil from the oil sump.
Disconnect the upper coupling and undo the motor fastening bolts and lift it using the winch.
Place the motor on wooden blocks in a vertical position on the ground.
Undo the pump base bolts and the discharge line bolts.
Lift the pump using the beach shed winch.
Place the pump on the ground on wooden blocks.
Measure the clearance of the impeller with the stationary part.
Dismantle the stationary part around the impeller (mouth ring).
Dismantle the pump impeller using the puller, check it, measure the clearance and record it.
Dismantle the stationary impeller and check it.
Support the pump shaft from below.
Dismantle the pump Duct connection and remove it (the lower connection).
Dismantle the shaft assembly coupling and remove the lower shaft connection.
Dismantle the lower coupling and remove the upper shaft connection.
Check the shaft sleeves corresponding to the bearings.
Check the thrust bearing, inspect it and remove it as required.
After inspection and verifying the condition, replace as required and reassemble in reverse order.
After the repair and reinstallation are complete, run the pump and check the condition in terms of:

- Vibration - discharge pressure and quantity - motor operating current
-
Thrust bearing oil temperature
in accordance with the performance curves

Introduction
This document covers the periodic maintenance of the main cooling pump. The document was prepared by Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman and Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh on 14 June 2003, and the electronic correspondence was carried out over the Internet with the assistance of Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman.
It was implemented based on previous experience by Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh. The document was reviewed by Eng. Abouda El-Banna, Inspection and Quality Control Engineer, and Eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Abdel Ghaffar, General Manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy, Head of the Power Stations Sector.
Safety precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority.
Use safety equipment: helmet, shoes and ear muffs.
Fence off the work area and place warning signs.
Isolate the pump electrically and take the switch out of service.
Isolate the pump mechanically by closing the discharge and suction valves and the bearing cooling valve.
Tools, instruments and equipment used
Helmet and safety shoes
Helmet and safety shoes
Chain block or Tirfor and its accessories (wire ropes and locks).
Complete tool set: wrenches of all types, open-end, ring and Allen keys.
Vernier caliper and dial caliper.
8-inch puller and feeler gauge.
Wooden blocks.
Spare parts that may be changed as required:
Remarks | Quantity | Item | No.
Locally manufactured | 3 | Rubber bearing sleeve 114 mm | 1
Locally manufactured | 3 | Stainless steel sleeve 114 mm | 2
Locally manufactured | 6 | Impeller vanes | 3
Locally manufactured | 2 | Stainless steel shaft coupling | 4
Imported | 1 | Thrust bearing | 5
Work steps to be carried out
Open the work order. | 1
Disconnect the pump, then disconnect the motor terminals | 2
Drain the oil from the oil sump. | 3
Disconnect the upper coupling and undo the motor fastening bolts and lift it using the winch. | 4
Place the motor on wooden blocks in a vertical position on the ground. | 5
Undo the pump base bolts and the discharge line bolts. | 6
Lift the pump using the beach shed winch. | 7
Place the pump on the ground on wooden blocks. | 8
Measure the clearance of the impeller with the stationary part. | 9
Dismantle the stationary part around the impeller (mouth ring). | 10
Dismantle the pump impeller using the puller, check it, measure the clearance and record it. | 11
Dismantle the stationary impeller and check it. | 12
Support the pump shaft from below. | 13
Dismantle the pump Duct connection and remove it (the lower connection). | 14
Dismantle the shaft assembly coupling and remove the lower shaft connection. | 15
Dismantle the lower coupling and remove the upper shaft connection. | 16
Check the pump bearings (Rubber Coated). | 17
Check the shaft sleeves corresponding to the bearings. | 18
Dismantle the oil cooling fan. | 19
Remove the oil sump cover. | 20
Check the thrust bearing, inspect it and remove it as required. | 21
After inspection and verifying the condition, replace as required and reassemble in reverse order. | 22
After the repair and reinstallation are complete, run the pump and check the condition in terms of: | 23
- Vibration - discharge pressure and quantity - motor operating current
-
Thrust bearing oil temperature
in accordance with the performance curves |
